note: Hand-maintained corrections merged into data/grammar.json by scripts/build-grammar.js. The raw manual harvests next to this file are never edited. Every entry says why.

cd.why: CD is the real short form of ChangeDestination; the MA2 page is titled ChangeDest and its CD syntax lines are not picked up as an alias.

Import.why: /File "x.xml" and /Path "..." are accepted by the console and used in real plugins; the manual's Import page lists only /noconfirm /quiet /path.

cd.why: CD is the real short form of ChangeDestination on grandMA3; the manual only spells the long form.

Import.why: /File "x.xml" and /Path "..." work on the console (Import Plugin 3 /File "X.xml" /Path "C:/..."); the manual's Import page does not list /File.

unknownKeywordIgnorePrefixes.why: Underscore-prefixed commands are internal/debug commands (_DebugSpeedMultiplier) that no manual page documents.
